title: CROSS-MORSE: Cross-Spectral Control of Message Passing in Frozen Graph Neural Networks (reference implementation)
description: CROSS-MORSE reference implementation for inference-time control of frozen graph neural networks. Includes seven dataset adapters, 21 configurations, experiment and Slurm drivers, tests, environment specifications, two complete synthetic examples, artifact-based result builders and the one-command reconstruction of the paper's tables and figures. The release demo-artifacts holds a complete execution of the pipeline on public data on CPU; AVAILABILITY.md lists the measured outputs of the paper's GPU runs and their publication status. Companion manuscript under review.
